Consequently there is no realized-outcome evidence of product/process disruption (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5) — the only integration-related material located was pre-closing forward-looking risk boilerplate marked [UNVERIFIED]. With no documented post-closing trajectory for the acquired business, both interface pathways are coded uncertain rather than 0, consistent with the slice's own no-record determination.
